title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Agents adjust mask-wearing probability based on the proportion of their network neighbors wearing masks, weighted by social influence susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Organizations mandate masks at locations; persons decide to comply based on propensity and enforcement level; locations monitor and apply warnings/fines.

interactions.name: information_campaign_and_misinformation
interactions.description: Organizations disseminate messages affecting risk perception and trust; misinformation spreads peer-to-peer and via global signals, impacting beliefs and adoption.

interactions.name: market_access_and_cost
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from the market; price, inventory, and subsidies affect ability to adopt and maintain mask-wearing.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contextual_exposure
interactions.description: Persons move through locations with different mask requirements and enforcement, affecting immediate mask decisions and peer observation.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_optional
interactions.description: If enabled, interactions at locations lead to infections where masks reduce transmission probability; disease prevalence feeds back into risk perception.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step and averaged over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: subgroup_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rates by demographic or network subgroups (e.g., age, occupation, SES, political orientation).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption exceeds a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Duration that adoption remains above a threshold without falling below it for a minimum consecutive period.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of interactions at mandate locations where agents comply with mask requirements.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections between scenarios with and without mask adoption (only if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: R_effective
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time under simulated mask behaviors (only if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: enforcement_actions
metrics.description: Counts of warnings and fines issued over time as a proxy for enforcement burden.

metrics.name: mask_access_inequality
metrics.description: Disparity measure (e.g., Gini or gap) in mask inventory or adoption across SES groups.

validation_criteria.name: RMSE_vs_observed_adoption
validation_criteria.description: For calibrated runs against empirical adoption data, root mean squared error should be below a target threshold (e.g., RMSE < 0.07).

validation_criteria.name: adoption_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate variance over the last 30 days below a threshold (e.g., variance < 0.01) indicating a stable regime.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Parameter search terminates when improvement in objective (e.g., RMSE) is less than 1e-4 over 20 iterations.

validation_criteria.name: no_excessive_stockouts
validation_criteria.description: Share of days with market inventory at zero should be below a threshold (e.g., < 5%) unless simulating shock scenarios.
